verdict.rationale: treg ships an official CLI, but the evidence never documents a workflow for staging or building a server, pushing it to a registry or host, and installing it into agents. The closest features do not deliver this story: `treg upload clis` shares CLIs already on a machine as team tools, vendor listings are submitted as a GitHub pull request rather than through the CLI, and `/plugin install treg@treg` installs treg itself into an agent.

support.subject: As a developer, I can drive the publish-and-deploy workflow from an official CLI — authenticate, stage or build a server, push it, and install it into agents
